author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

`TruthGraph::NodeRef` stores `NodeKind kind`, an `enum class` with `uint8_t` underlying type. ROOT streams an enum member as a 4-byte int (StreamerInfo type 3). It copies those 4 bytes from the object in memory, so the three upper bytes hold uninitialised padding. These bytes change from run to run. FWLite python reads the 4 bytes and returns wrong kinds, for example 1684948225. Compiled code uses only the low byte, so C++ consumers read the correct kind.

This PR makes `NodeRef` a class with a private `uint8_t kind_` and `int64_t key_`, a constructor, and the accessors `kind()` and `key()`. `NodeRef` goes to ClassVersion 4. An ioread rule reads version 3 files: it takes the low byte of the on-file int. A release without this PR cannot read a version 4 file correctly: it reads every node as kind `GenParticle` with key 0 and gives no error. 

The branch `TruthGraph_mix` becomes 3 bytes per node smaller uncompressed and 10 to 14% smaller compressed. The content does not change.

Note for reviewers: the data members are renamed, so a release without this PR reads a file written with it as kind GenParticle and key 0 for every node, with no error. Files written before this PR read correctly with it.
title: Store TruthGraph::NodeRef kind in one byte
